Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 134. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Weapon Technique
Ki Cost: 25 Ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Weapon
that you are proficient with
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: Yes
You fire a flurry of blasts from your weapon, basing it
out of the type of weapon that you wield. Make a
number of combo attack roll equal to half your
proficiency bonus. On a hit, you deal your weapon’s
damage.
